title: Network Details

panels.title: Cold Key Details
panels.description: Cold key address and public key.

panels.title: Feegrant Details
panels.description: Fee grant key addresses, allowance type and spend limit.

panels.title: MLNode Status
panels.description: Status of each MLNode check. Each box represents one node.

panels.title: GPU Details
panels.description: Per-GPU memory, utilization and temperature across all MLNodes. Handles any number of nodes dynamically.

panels.title: Block Height
panels.description: Chain block height over time. A flat line indicates stalled sync. Multiple lines appear if several instances are scraped.

panels.title: Seconds Since Last Block
panels.description: Time elapsed since the latest block was produced. Sustained values above 30 s indicate the node is falling behind.
